verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents its own analytics: the platform intro lists analytics, and the Insights Agent works over 'Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics'. On-Call Readiness Reports give a team-filtered view of each responder's readiness status, which touches on on-call health. However, no evidence shows MTTA/MTTR trend dashboards or explicit incident-load metrics. Missing for 10: documented MTTA/MTTR trend reporting, explicit incident-load/volume metrics, on-call burden/health analytics beyond notification-rule readiness, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving

citations.quote: The platform supports this through hundreds of native integrations, on-call scheduling, escalation policies, AIOps, business-wide response orchestration, and analytics.
delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights based on your Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics
Every report provides a Team-filtered overview of each responder's on-call readiness status
